claims.claim: Planning selects only CAA-02 / TASK-410, records the reauthenticated TASK-409 reviewed-source inclusion, and preserves earlier selections and unselected CAA-03/04/05.
The bounded read-only consultation API consumes sealed ExperienceCuts and an exact transient candidate without lifecycle mutation, task selection, audit invocation or dispatch.

Optional semantic features cite authenticated immutable TASK fields and the original snapshot; source prose remains withheld and unsupported meaning remains UNKNOWN. Default CAA-01 output remains compatible.

A1 provides structured and lexical comparison; B1 supports related-feature mechanism analogies while retaining positive, negative, unknown and non-applicable episodes and requiring eligible opposing counterexamples.

Responses contain zero to three distinct hypotheses with validated citation support, applicability, decisive differences, experiments, effects, falsifiers and uncertainty. Invalid citations and certainty claims produce abstention.
Negative fixtures construct historical cuts, forged and moved references, substituted candidates, hostile source text and unauthorized response fields, and assert isolation or rejection.

The bounded comparative fixture pairs identical A1/B1 inputs with predeclared grounding oracles and computes counterexample, abstention and overhead measures; simulated responses do not establish live-model superiority.
Consultation supports explicit abstention and unavailability outcomes without authoring hooks, while existing source-authentication failures propagate.

Mapping and JSON adapters receive normalized equivalent requests. Invocation, request, response and output limits are enforced without retry or rerouting; adapter adversaries cover malformed responses and attribution mismatch.

The clean committed delta contains exactly the seven authorized paths. Documentation and boundary tests preserve HUMAN_ON_DEMAND policy, existing authority boundaries and minimum-sufficient-v1 verification ownership.
